title: Complaint before RBI Integrated Ombudsman for Unauthorized Electronic Transactions
whenToUse: Use when customer suffers unauthorized digital debit, phishing, or bank deficiency and the regulated entity has failed to resolve grievance within 30 days.
variantComparisonNote: Administrative complaint before RBI Ombudsman. Distinct from consumer complaint under CPA 2019 and civil suit.
youWillNeed: Bank account statement, copy of complaint sent to bank branch, bank rejection letter/acknowledgment ticket, police cyber cell report.
legalBasis: Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2021; RBI Master Circular DBR.No.Leg.BC.78/09.07.005/2017-18; Section 35A Banking Regulation Act, 1949.
mandatoryStatutoryIngredients: Pre-requisite complaint submitted to bank more than 30 days prior
Zero liability notification given to bank within 3 working days
Failure of bank to reverse unauthorized electronic debit within 10 working days
Compensation sought within Ombudsman scheme ceiling of ₹20 Lakhs + ₹1 Lakh for harassment

particulars.label: Branch Location
particulars.description: City of bank branch maintaining account

aiBlocks.title: Details of Unauthorized Debit
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Narrate chronological facts of unauthorized digital debits, immediate reporting to bank helpline, cyber cell registration and denial of OTP sharing.

aiBlocks.title: Breach of RBI Master Directions
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Demonstrate bank's failure to maintain fraud monitoring systems and violation of RBI Master Circular on Customer Zero Liability.

aiBlocks.title: Restoration & Compensation Claim
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Specify exact financial restitution of disputed sum with savings bank interest and compensation for harassment under Ombudsman Scheme 2021.
